arguments.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, status FROM bookings GROUP BY status

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(DISTINCT h.hold_id) as hold_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_id) as charge_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id GROUP BY b.booking_id ORDER BY b.status, b.booking_id
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" ORDER BY name

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, h.booking_id as has_hold, c.charge_id as has_charge FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT c.charge_id, c.booking_id, c.state, b.status FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON c.booking_id = b.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending"
SELECT idempotency_key, booking_id, state, final_state FROM provider_ledger WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status = "pending") ORDER BY idempotency_key
SELECT c.charge_id, c.booking_id, c.idempotency_key, c.state FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON c.booking_id = b.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" AND c.state = "submitted" LIMIT 3
SELECT b.booking_id, c.state FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, c.state, o.event_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN outbox o ON b.booking_id = o.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending"
